topic: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood
script: An octopus has three hearts. Two of them pump blood through the gills, and the third pumps it around the body. Its blood is blue because it carries oxygen with copper instead of iron. The main heart actually stops beating while the octopus swims. That may be one reason octopuses prefer to crawl instead of swim. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
